description: This file is a Python source script that sets up an AI-powered conversational bot pipeline using various services and handlers. It defines asynchronous functions to initialize and run a pipeline for a WebRTC-based chat, involving speech-to-text, language modeling, text-to-speech, and transport event handling.

classes.name: LLMContext
classes.description: Data class managing conversational context for LLM interactions.

classes.name: LLMContextAggregatorPair
classes.description: Class linking context aggregation for user and assistant in the pipeline.

classes.name: LLMUserAggregatorParams
classes.description: Parameters to configure user-specific context aggregation.

classes.name: Pipeline
classes.description: Defines the processing pipeline integrating various services.

classes.name: PipelineTask
classes.description: Encapsulates a pipeline execution with specific parameters.

classes.name: PipelineParams
classes.description: Configuration parameters for a pipeline run.

classes.name: PipelineRunner
classes.description: Controller to execute and manage the pipeline, handling signals.

classes.name: GroqSTTService
classes.description: Service wrapper for speech-to-text functionality with Groq.

classes.name: GroqLLMService
classes.description: Service wrapper for large language model inference with Groq.

classes.name: GroqTTSService
classes.description: Service wrapper for text-to-speech synthesis with Groq.

classes.name: BaseTransport
classes.description: Base class for transport mechanisms (WebRTC, FastAPI websockets etc.).

methods.name: run_bot(transport: BaseTransport, runner_args: RunnerArguments)

methods.name: bot(runner_args: RunnerArguments)
